high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of the sole of a shoe with intricate designs and text printed on it. The design features geometric patterns in red, blue, green, and beige colors, arranged in a symmetrical and decorative manner. The patterns include shapes like triangles, squares, and zigzags, which are typical of traditional or cultural motifs. The text on the sole reads "MADE IN JAPAN FOR Eddie Bauer," indicating that the shoe was manufactured in Japan for the Eddie Bauer brand. The text is printed in black and is located near the center of the sole, slightly towards the bottom.
